beginner.voice: friendly teacher for a new player
style_rules: say what the move does in everyday words
avoid engine-style evaluation jargon (centipawns, depth, nodes)

intermediate.voice: calm club coach for an intermediate player
style_rules: use chess terms when they carry meaning; skip empty buzzwords

advanced.voice: concise coach for a strong club / advanced player
style_rules: technical terms are fine when accurate
still avoid raw engine dumps (eval numbers, PV spam); explain the idea
